name: Aneimo Neo+ ~Second Sisters~
source:
This is a full remake of Aneimo Neo with 8 total heroines. New heroines Asuka and Reiko join Mai and Nana, while subheroines Takami, Hazuki, Sakura and Sawako are all elevated to heroine status.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Aneimo Neo的全面翻拍版，共有8名女主角。新女主角明日香和丽子加入麻衣和娜娜的行列，而副女主角高海、叶月、小樱和泽子都被提升为女主角。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
